stable.notes: Adaptive review-audio cleanup is now visible, reversible, and off by default. When enabled, pressing Play may create a temporary replay-only cleanup copy while the immutable raw WAV remains the source of truth. Raw playback is always available, live capture and transcription preempt cleanup, and Stop or closing review cancels pending playback. Activation proves the selected server capability and rolls back automatically if verification fails. Needs glasses-server 6.21.32.
